entities.summary: Daniela Castelo was an Argentine journalist, eldest daughter of Adolfo Castelo (1940–2004). She attended secondary school in the Liceo Nacional 9 in Buenos Aires. She graduated in psychology at the University of Buenos Aires Faculty of Psychology.
